title: Rory Sutherland (Ogilvy): 'If you have ever wondered why 90% of interesting companies are either founder-run or family owned, this explains a lot'
summary: Ogilvy UK vice-chairman and behavioral economics evangelist Rory Sutherland quote-tweets Eric to his 152k-follower audience on launch eve — 128 likes / 8 retweets in the first hours.
blockquote: If you have ever wondered why 90% of interesting companies are either founder-run or family owned, this explains a lot.
attribution_title: Vice-chairman of Ogilvy UK; behavioral economics writer; columnist at The Spectator
